decisions.reason: As a newly launched product very close to the firm's core reusable packaging business in a growing industry, it is likely to remain below any immediate drop threshold while the firm uses its scale and slack to learn about demand.

Because this valve builds directly on the established bulk-container offer and was given its own page, management would likely keep it as a complementary extension unless clear underperformance emerges.

Although still less visibly established than the product launches, the take-back service fits the firm's strategic move toward service-based and sustainable reusable packaging, so a large firm would likely continue it while evaluating results.
